name: Kalakriti Crafts
about: A family-run collective of 40 artisans making block-printed textiles, blue pottery and brass accents. Every piece is made to order.

name: Threadwork Studio
about: Small-batch kurtas, stoles and shirts woven on handlooms in Maharashtra and Odisha. Natural dyes, no fast fashion.

name: Gadget Gully
about: Tested audio, charging and desk gadgets. Every product carries a 12-month replacement warranty.

name: Spice Trail Pantry
about: Spices bought directly from Kerala and Karnataka farms, ground in small lots and packed within a week.

name: Green Leaf Nursery
about: Hardy indoor plants, planters and seeds raised in our nursery. Plants ship in ventilated boxes and arrive healthy or we replace them.

name: Pagebound Books
about: An independent bookshop with a curated shelf of fiction, non-fiction and notebooks from small Indian presses.
